programmes.d: Matt leaves Dodge City unprotected when he sets out to find a killer.
An outlaw threatens to kill Doc if he does not help his wounded buddy.
Matt and Chester act as decoys to ambush outlaws that are masking their crimes as those of renegade Indians.
Matt discovers that he was the intended victim of a murder he is investigating.
Matt helps a woman whose suitors are about to duel for her affections.
A landowner tries to terrorize homesteaders off their land.
An old buffalo hunter swears revenge on the skinner that left him to die.
Matt traps a cattleman who shot two homesteaders.
An Indian woman faces prejudice for her father's raid on Dodge City.
A bank robber murders his wife and frames Tobeel for the crime.
After a young gunfighter brazenly kills an over-matched rancher, the rancher's brother wants Matt to settle the score.
Townspeople protect an outlaw they believe has reformed.
The shooting of several members of an outlaw gang, though in self defense, triggers an emotional crisis in Matt, haunted by memories of all the men he has killed.

An uneasy truce between the cattlemen and homesteaders of post-Civil War Abilene, Kansas is broken, resulting in a territorial war between the two groups. Sheriff Dan Mitchell must try to broker a lasting peace.

A bounty killer, Clips, has been for a long time on the trail of John Cooler, an elderly bandit whose head hangs a bounty of twenty thousand dollars. John is also wanted by the Mexican Juarez and his gang.
A woman comes a long way from the east to Dodge, only to realize that her fiancé has lost all his money and does not wish to marry her.
A dance-hall girl manipulates her admirers into facing each other in gunfights.
A former gunslinger's past catches up to him.
An official from Washington sets out to tame Dodge City.
Kitty gets annoyed by a pair of old farmers who are each trying to have a fling with her.
Matt reluctantly arrests Chester for murder.
A photographer from the east seeks to immortalize the violent West.
A saloon girl does not want her ex-fiancé to know about her job.
Matt fakes his death to lure a gunman out in the open.
A former gunslinger is goaded into a duel by his fiancee's brother.
Matt seeks evidence to convict a poker dealer of murdering a gambler.
A gunman manipulates two boys into facing him in a duel.
Matt goes after an outlaw who shot Chester.
Kitty's father arrives in Dodge to try and take her back to New Orleans.
A retired Army officer asks Matt to appoint him deputy.
A gunman tries to start a fight with a braggart.
A hot-tempered man thinks Matt is pursuing his wife.
The man who threatened to kill Chester arrives in town.
Kitty's old boyfriend sets her up in a bank robbery.
A young man claims that his father committed a murder.
A girl from the east comes to Dodge to experience life in the west.
After he is saved from hanging, a drifterplots revenge against the men who tried to lynch him.
Inspired by the play Romeo and Juliet, the children of feuding family patriarchs fall in love.
Matt hunts down two drifters who dragged Chester and left him for dead.
The people of Dodge gets suspicious of Jim Cobbett when his second wifevanishes just like his first.
Matt tracks down a gunman who robbed a stagecoach Barry Atwater, Jolene Brand, and George Cisar appear.
The residents of Dodge are wondering where Joe Nadler gets all his money – and where he goes to spend it.
